scholarships.name: Postcode Bursary
scholarships.description: The postcode bursary is in place to help students who live in deprived areas. All students that apply for the bursary will automatically be registered for the postcode bursary. The maximum amount payable per year of study is £250.

scholarships.name: Care Leaver Bursary
scholarships.description: The legal definition of a care leaver comes from The Children (Leaving Care) Act 2000 which states that a Care Leaver is someone who has been in the care of the Local Authority for a period of 13 weeks or more spanning their 16th birthday. The maximum amount payable per year of study is £1,000.

scholarships.name: Disability Bursary
scholarships.description: The disability bursary seeks to support students who have a disability.
